div.head: Hn mon 3.1
div.ab: Et si in alio comitatu mutando denarios captus fuerit, captus sit ut falsonarius.
Et si in ali[o] comitatu mutando denarios captus fuerit, captus sit ut falsonarius.
And if he has been seized recasting money in another county, he shall be regarded as a forger.

note.seg: si fügen zu Sc Hg K; sic Edd.; ‘superfluous’ Riley Mun. Gildh. Lond. II 649
si added by Sc Hg K; sic Edd.; ‘superfluous’ Riley Mun. Gildh. Lond. II 649
Das Umprägen in fremdem Gerichtsbezirk beweist die Absicht des Heimlichen; s. d. Gl 1c. Münzer setzten falschen Prägernamen auf minderwertigen Pfennig, um diesen nicht verantworten zu müssen
Re-minting in another jurisdiction proves an intent of secrecy; see that word in Gl 1c. Moneyers put a false moneyer's name on an inferior penny so as not to have to answer for it
